tweets.text:
not great for Neolabs or open weight ecosystem 

Great for Anthropic and OpenAI

It does give an opening to other large companies to own more of the open weight ecosystem https://t.co/p5hpqrGLJ3

Codex and Claude Code are products for people who already know how to work with agents…..

If you try Grok Bot, it is closer to a product for people who don’t. 

By removing the requirement that the user understand sessions, tools, or configuration, it can address a population that other agent products structurally cannot reach… including first-time users outside traditional tech markets.

There is a massive interface unlock here
